question: By how many billion dollars is the Li-ion battery recycling market projected to grow between 2025 and 2030, and at what annual growth rate?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%billion%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%2030%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cagr%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%growth rate%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%market%'

WITH t AS (SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id = 'p2.L58'), n AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '\$([0-9.]+) billion in', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS a, CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'to \$([0-9.]+) billion by', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS b FROM t) SELECT round(b - a, 1) AS increase_billion FROM n
